children: SITE Centers Corp. (NYSE: SITC) announced today the sale of Shoppes at Paradise Pointe (Fort Walton Beach, FL) for approximately $8.4 million. Net proceeds after adjustments for certain prorations, allocations and other closing adjustments was approximately $8.0 million.

SITE Centers is an owner and manager of open-air shopping centers. The Company is a self-administered and self-managed REIT operating as a fully integrated real estate company and is publicly traded on the New York Stock Exchange under the ticker symbol SITC.
